models.name: Qwen3.8-35B-A3B
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-35B-A3B (Empero community distillation of Qwen3.8 reasoning into the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE)
models.vram_min: 12GB (RTX 3060, with 26 MoE layers offloaded to system RAM)

engines.hardware: RTX 3060 12GB + 16GB system RAM, llama-server with Flash Attention and Q8_0 KV cache, 26 MoE layers on the CPU; ~550 tok/s prompt processing
engines.quant: Q4_K_M weights, Q8_0 K/V cache, 262K configured context; --n-cpu-moe 26 -c 262144 -fa on --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --reasoning on

models.why: A 35B MoE distilled from Qwen3.8 reasoning into the A3B architecture runs ~50 tok/s decode and ~550 tok/s prefill at a 262K context on a 12GB RTX 3060 plus 16GB of system RAM, with 26 MoE layers pushed to the CPU — the whole point being an agent-sized model on a card people already own.
